name: Writing
when: Drafting a narrative, summary or answer

variants.name: Pencil
variants.desc: A pencil writes line after line on a page.

variants.name: Speech bubble
variants.desc: Lines fill a speech bubble as it murmurs along.

variants.name: Rewrite
variants.desc: Writes a line, flips the pencil, rubs half out and writes it again.

variants.name: Pages
variants.desc: Pages fly out of it and stack up at its side.

variants.name: Scribbles
variants.desc: Scribbles of writing float up out of its head, one at a time.
